packageRules.description: Group all non-major (minor/patch) updates into a single PR per manager to cut down on noise; majors still get their own PR for review.

The vendored Nexi SDK binaries are not renovatable: android/libs/*.aar are committed .aar files with no package registry backing them, and ios/scripts/fetch_frameworks.sh pins Nexi's XPay/NPGSDK xcframework archive URLs with hardcoded SHA-256 checksums. Both must be bumped by hand when Nexi ships a new SDK version (see README.md / TESTING.md release checklist) rather than by an automated PR.
